title: Legacy Java Observable and Observer
purpose: Preserve historic Java implementation while clearly marking legacy API and correct changed/pull behavior.
alt: 레거시 Java Observable을 상속한 WeatherData와 Observer·DisplayElement 구현, setChanged 알림과 데이터 조회 흐름
requiredChecks: WeatherData extends java.util.Observable class; display classes implement java.util.Observer and DisplayElement.
Observable addObserver(o), deleteObserver(o), protected setChanged(), notifyObservers() methods are correct.
WeatherData measurementsChanged calls setChanged() then notifyObservers(); no-arg notification passes null argument.
Observer update(Observable o,Object arg) pulls data via WeatherData getters; CurrentConditionsDisplay does not depend on pushed float arguments here.
Legacy APIs are labelled deprecated since Java 9; no guarantee of observer notification order.
